meaning.hi: इस शरीर में दो पक्षी: जीव और ईश साथ

words.sanskrit: tayoh jivah phalam bhunkte karmano na maheshvarah

meaning.en: the soul eats the fruit of action, not Maheshvara
meaning.hi: जीव कर्मफल भोगता है, महेश्वर नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: kevalam sakshi-rupena vina bhogam maheshvarah

meaning.en: Maheshvara exists purely as witness, without enjoyment
meaning.hi: महेश्वर केवल साक्षी रूप, भोग रहित

words.sanskrit: bhedah kalpitah mayaya tayoh

meaning.en: the difference between the two is imagined by Maya
meaning.hi: दोनों का भेद माया द्वारा कल्पित

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: ghata-akasha-matha-akashau yatha akasha-prabhedatah

meaning.en: as the space in a pot and a hall differ by the container
meaning.hi: घटाकाश-मठाकाश आकाश-भेद से

words.sanskrit: kalpitau paramau jiva-shiva-rupena kalpitau

meaning.en: the soul and Shiva are similarly imagined as separate
meaning.hi: जीव-शिव रूप में वैसे ही कल्पित

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tattvatah cha shivah sakshat chit jivah cha svatah sada

meaning.en: in truth, Shiva is directly consciousness, and the soul is too
meaning.hi: तत्त्वतः शिव साक्षात् चित्, जीव भी सदा

words.sanskrit: chich-chidakarato bhinna na bhinna chittva-hanitah

meaning.en: not different in the form consciousness takes
meaning.hi: चित्-आकार में भिन्न नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: chitah chit na chid-akarad bhidyate jada-rupatah

meaning.en: consciousness is divided only by the nature of inert matter
meaning.hi: चेतना जड़-रूप से ही विभक्त प्रतीत होती है

words.sanskrit: bhidyate chet jado bhedah chit eka sarvada khalu

meaning.en: if division were real, consciousness would fragment; it remains one
meaning.hi: यदि भेद सच होता तो चित् खंडित होती; वह सदा एक

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tarkatah cha pramanat cha chid-ekatva-vyavasthiteh

meaning.en: through reasoning and scripture, the oneness of consciousness is established
meaning.hi: तर्क और प्रमाण से चिदेकत्व स्थापित

words.sanskrit: chid-ekatva-parijnane na shochati na muhyati

meaning.en: knowing this oneness, one neither grieves nor is deluded
meaning.hi: चिदेकत्व जानकर न शोक न मोह

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: advaitam paramanandam shivam yati tu kaivalam

meaning.en: through non-duality, one attains supreme bliss and liberation
meaning.hi: अद्वैत से परमानंद और कैवल्य की प्राप्ति

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: adhishthanam samastasya jagatah satya-chid-ghanam

meaning.en: the foundation of the universe, dense existence-consciousness
meaning.hi: समस्त जगत का अधिष्ठान, सत्यचिद्घन

words.sanskrit: aham asmi iti nishchitya vitashoko bhavet munih

meaning.en: settling in 'I am that,' the sage becomes free of sorrow
meaning.hi: 'मैं वही हूँ' निश्चय कर मुनि वीतशोक होता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sva-sharire svayam jyotih-svarupam sarva-sakshinam

meaning.en: self-luminous self, witness of all, within one's own body
meaning.hi: अपने शरीर में स्वयंप्रकाश, सर्वसाक्षी

words.sanskrit: kshina-doshah prapashyanti na itare mayaya avritah

meaning.en: those with thinned faults see it; others, veiled by Maya, do not
meaning.hi: क्षीणदोष देखते हैं; अन्य माया-आवृत नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: evam rupa-parijnanam yasya asti para-yoginah

meaning.en: the supreme yogi who holds this complete recognition
meaning.hi: जिस परम योगी को यह पूर्ण ज्ञान है

words.sanskrit: kutrachit gamanam nasti tasya purna-svarupinah

meaning.en: has nowhere to go, abiding in his own fullness
meaning.hi: उसे कहीं जाना नहीं, पूर्णस्वरूप में स्थित

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: akasham ekam sampurnam kutrachit na eva gacchhati

meaning.en: the one complete sky never goes anywhere
meaning.hi: एक सम्पूर्ण आकाश कहीं नहीं जाता

words.sanskrit: tadvat sva-atma-parijnani kutrachit na eva gacchhati

meaning.en: likewise the self-knower never goes anywhere
meaning.hi: वैसे ही आत्मज्ञानी कहीं नहीं जाता

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sa yah ha vai tat paramam brahma yah veda vai munih

meaning.en: the sage who truly knows that supreme Brahman
meaning.hi: जो मुनि उस परम ब्रह्म को जानता है

words.sanskrit: brahmaiva bhavati svasthah sat-chid-ananda-matrikah

meaning.en: becomes Brahman itself, settled, made of existence-consciousness-bliss
meaning.hi: स्वयं ब्रह्म बन जाता है, स्वस्थ, सच्चिदानंदमात्रक

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
